$comment: An example plugin manifest, and the shape doc/BUILD8.md section 6.2
specifies. It is the plugin author's document and travels with the
plugin; host/example.host.lua's `plugins` block is the operator's, and
says which plugins a deployment wires.
The host reads only the flat metadata here: schema, plugin.exec,
capability its name and wake policy. `args`, `result` and `errors` are
read past without being looked at -- validation is the plugin's job and
the tooling's, and no JSON Schema validator belongs in a binary whose
point is to static-link onto a lean box. Keep them anyway: they are the
contract a plugin author writes against and a generator reads.
Self-contained on purpose. There is no external $ref, because a plugin
load must never become a network fetch.

capabilities.name: get
capabilities.$comment: reissue: a GET is idempotent, so an instance that hibernated mid-call can simply be asked again on wake.

body.$comment: The wire is msgpack and carries a real bin type; JSON Schema has none. Base64-in-string is the stated convention (BUILD8 section 6.1) so that each plugin does not invent its own.

capabilities.name: post
capabilities.$comment: error: a POST is not safe to repeat, and the host cannot know whether the first one landed. The guest is told the call was lost and decides for itself.
